name: com.openugd.ui
description: Three uGUI components that need no shader, material or texture of their own: UIFlippable mirrors a graphic about its rect centre without a negative scale, GradientMeshEffect writes a horizontal, vertical, radial or diamond gradient into the vertex colours, and EmptyGraphic is an invisible raycast target for hit areas and invisible buttons.

samples.description: All three components on one canvas, built in code: text mirrored four ways by UIFlippable plus a copy that flips every second, the four GradientMeshEffect shapes (Horizontal animating its offset) plus Radial again on a graphic whose pivot is in the corner, and an invisible Button whose hit area is an EmptyGraphic. Put UIComponentsDemo on an empty GameObject and enter Play mode.
